Ram Temple Donation Irregularities Under Scrutiny Amid Theft Allegations

Allegations of theft and irregularities have surfaced concerning donations made to the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. Investigations are underway, with police recovering forged receipts used to collect funds. The temple trust has formed a committee to oversee accounts, while political figures have commented on the situation, with some demanding accountability from the Prime Minister.
